An overhead isometric three-quarter 45-degree view of a snow-covered industrial neighborhood in northeastern China on a winter night. A weathered roadside bus shelter with a corrugated metal roof and a long wooden bench, thick snow piled on the roof and along the curb. One elderly woman in a padded dark winter coat sits at the end of the bench, hands resting in her lap. Uneven snow covers cracked asphalt and concrete paving, with compressed footprints, tire tracks and small patches of wet dark slush. A broad open walking route leads from the lower left foreground to the shelter. Red brick workers housing, low factory walls, shuttered small shops and a parked utility truck with snow on its hood and roof line the street. Rusted drainpipes, overhead wires, peeling painted metal and rough brick have visible depth, thickness and surface relief. Snow-covered dark fence posts and a low brick wall frame the immediate foreground. A warm amber streetlamp lights the woman, bench and falling snowflakes; cool blue-teal ambient light fills the street. Granular snow, damp asphalt reflections, rough metal, wooden grain, soft contact shadows under every object, bounced light beneath the shelter. Worn 1980s Northeast China socialist-era buildings and street furniture. Muted teal-and-amber palette, hand-painted brushwork integrated into the material surfaces, clearly modeled 3D forms.
